title: Wrong Items Kept under Delivery Claims: Order Age, Regular-Price Lines and the Keep Base
content:
Recovery schedule for Delivery Claims: the keep base of a wrong-item keep charge follows the age of the order and the price the line sold at.

**Rule.** The keep base depends on the age of the order and the price the line sold at: for a line sold at regular price on an order placed more than 60 calendar days before today, the keep base is the line's booked unit price times the units compensated on that line, less 30% of it, with no tax share; for a regular-price line on an order placed more than 30 and at most 60 calendar days before today, the keep base is the merchandise compensation for the line less 15% of it; in every other case the keep base is the merchandise compensation for the line.

## Terms

- The line: the order line the wrong item came in place of.
- Age of the order: calendar days from the order's placed date to today.
- Regular price: the booking line shows the price type regular; its unit price is the booked unit price.
- Units compensated on that line, and merchandise compensation for the line: the units, and the amounts with their tax share, of the claim's merchandise refund entries on that line.

| Price type of the line | Order age | Keep base |
|---|---|---|
| regular | more than 60 days | booked unit price times units compensated, less 30%, no tax share |
| regular | 31 to 60 days | merchandise compensation for the line, less 15% |
| regular | 30 days or less | merchandise compensation for the line |
| any other | any | merchandise compensation for the line |

## Worked figures (hypothetical line: unit price 40.00 USD, 1 unit compensated, merchandise compensation 43.20 USD with tax share)

| Order age, price type | Keep base |
|---|---|
| 61 days, regular | 40.00 less 30% — 28.00 USD |
| 60 days, regular | 43.20 less 15% — 36.72 USD |
| 31 days, regular | 43.20 less 15% — 36.72 USD |
| 30 days, regular | 43.20 USD |
| 90 days, a price type other than regular | 43.20 USD |
